subtitle.en: UPESSC PGT (Lecturer) · subject code 08 · topic-wise notes on the official 2026 syllabus

practice.about: Five expected papers for December 2026 (90 questions each, in the pattern of the May 2026 paper) and past papers of UP PGT (2016, 2021, 2026), UPPSC GIC lecturer (2021, 2026) and DSSSB PGT (2021, 2025, 2026) mathematics: every question solved step by step, checked by a second mathematician and linked to its notes topic.

about.en: The units follow the official 2026 syllabus of PGT Mathematics. Each topic keeps the full text of the notes PDF, with explanations, worked examples and shortcuts added. All 18 chapters of the notes are ready.
